cited.quote: Kundrathur new Revenue Taluk is formed with Head Quarters at Kundrathur
Kalvarayan Hills, new Taluk is formed with Head Quarters at Kalvarayan Hills

rationale: C1 (G.O. 428, 12.11.2019) forms the new Kundrathur and Vandalur taluks; C3 (G.O. 424, same date) forms Thiruvennainallur and Kalvarayan Hills taluks. These are orders creating new taluks after the government took office. C4 only reports pre-2016 creations.

cited.quote: Sriperumbudur new Revenue Division is formed with Head Quarters at Sriperumbudur
Gudiyatham new Revenue Division is formed with Head Quarters at Gudiyatham

rationale: C3 (G.O. 428 dated 12.11.2019) forms the new Sriperumbudur Revenue Division; C5 (G.O. 430, same date) forms Gudiyatham, Vaniyambadi and Arakkonam divisions. C2 (2020) forms further divisions. Orders creating new revenue divisions were issued; the earliest in the extracts is 2019-11-12.

cited.quote: These rules have been issued vide G.O.(Ms.) No.13, Information Technology (e.Gov.I) Department, dated 02.12.2016
delivery of citizen centric services offered by various departments of Government of Tamil Nadu through mobile applications

rationale: C4 reports the electronic service delivery rules (G.O. 13, 02.12.2016) requiring all departmental services online within 5 years, with 165 services online so far and 300 more planned. C1 sanctions a single mobile app (2020). Services are only partly online and on mobile, not all.

cited.quote: the TASMAC retail vending liquor shops and the bars attached thereto are functioning from 12 noon to 10 pm

rationale: C1 shows shop closures (1000 TASMAC shops) and reduced hours for attached bars, but no order closing bars attached to retail liquor shops. C2 describes highway bars of FL licences closed under a Supreme Court order, a different category, and later reopening. No official step for this commitment.

cited.quote: everyday aavin milk societies are purchasing milk worth more than Rs.10 crore

rationale: C1-C3 are Aavin policy notes about procurement, marketing and allocations, but none shows any order or payment to cover Aavin's loss. C3 gives an allocation table without saying what it is for. C4 and C5 are unrelated. No official step for this commitment.

No extract mentions a Tamil chair at Harvard. C1 and C2 mention other university chairs (Ambedkar, Swami Dayanand), C5 a Tamil computing wing in the Tamil Virtual Academy; C3 and C4 are unrelated. Nothing is about this commitment.

cited.quote: the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Tamil Nadu amendment) Act, 2017
issued an Ordinance amending the relevant provisions of the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960

rationale: Directional commitment. C1 reports the state issued an Ordinance amending the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act to enable Jallikattu; C3 confirms the Tamil Nadu amendment Act, 2017 and Jallikattu Rules, 2017, with events conducted. A dedicated law exists; only the year (2017) is shown.

cited.quote: be enhanced to 9 months (270 days), with full pay, which may be spread over from the pre-confinement rest
be enhanced to 9 months (270 days) with full pay, which may be spread over

rationale: C2 is G.O. 105 dated 07.11.2016 raising maternity leave from 6 to 9 months for women government servants; C1 (2019) extends it to women Panchayat Secretaries and C4 amends the Fundamental Rules. Matches the promised 9 months.

cited.quote: A minimum of 25% of the goods and services procured by the Government Departments and State Public Sector Undertakings
giving purchase preference and tapping Government procurements through Government e-Market place (GeM) portal

rationale: C1 and C4 state a 25% mandatory MSME procurement norm in policy-note background text, with no state order or date shown. C2 (MSME Policy 2021 GO) only lists purchase preference and GeM access as a strategy, with no 20% target. No dedicated official step on the 20% procurement is shown.

cited.quote: the youth trained under the scheme will find job opportunities in repair and maintenance of these two wheelers

rationale: C1-C3 cover the Amma Two Wheeler subsidy for working women, a different scheme, and block-level ITI skill centres; C4 is a driver training centre; C5 is a general skill scheme. None shows two-wheeler repair training centres in panchayat unions.

cited.quote: Installation of Pulses processing units in Co-operative Marketing

rationale: C5 sanctions pulses processing units in cooperative marketing societies and C2 mentions pulses drying units, but neither procures or sells farmers' pulses. C1 and C4 cover copra procurement, a different crop. No step for procuring and selling pulses through cooperatives is shown.

cited.quote: Government is running 18 Minority hostels at Chennai, Vellore, Krishnagiri, Coimbatore, Thanjavur, Tiruchirappalli
16 Minority hostels are functioning at Chennai, Vellore, Krishnagiri, Coimbatore, Thanjavur

rationale: C4 (2019) lists 16 minority hostels; C3 (2020-21) lists 18, adding Cuddalore and Sivagangai, so new minority hostels were started. C2 says new hostels are opened based on demand. No GO is shown, so the date is only the year of the policy note.

No extract concerns methane or shale gas projects or any state decision barring schemes that affect delta farmers. C1, C3 and C4 describe bio-gas plant subsidies and rural programmes; C2 is a cyclone fuel advance; C5 is a solar pump scheme. None is about this commitment.

cited.quote: A water sports centre is functioning at Nagapattinam District Sports Complex

rationale: C2 mentions an existing water sports centre at Nagapattinam and beach game play fields in coastal districts, with no date or order creating sea water sports facilities. C1 and C3 cover stadiums and swimming pools. No official step for sea water sports facilities is shown.

cited.quote: The Government have accorded Administrative Sanction for Implementation of Athikadavu Avinashi scheme as Irrigation, Groundwater recharge and drinking

rationale: C2 reports administrative sanction for the Athikadavu Avinashi scheme at Rs.1652.00 crore on a DBOT basis, with the intake structure and pipeline only proposed. C1 and C3 show earlier sanctions for investigation and clearances in progress. No sign of works or operation yet.

cited.quote: permit the Director of Horticulture and Plantation Crops to implement the Crop Incentive Scheme for sensitive
help the farmer to forecast the market price, season and region based remunerative crop cultivation

rationale: C5 (G.O. 95, 13.05.2020) orders a Rs.2500 lakh incentive scheme for sensitive horticulture crops with price forecasting, aimed at assured returns. It covers selected crops only and does not show farmers receiving good prices. C1-C4 are general marketing or non-horticultural price support.

cited.quote: Passenger services have commenced in the elevated stretches from Chinnamalai to Airport and from Alandur to St. Thomas Mount.
Operations in the underground stretches are expected to commence shortly

rationale: C3 (Governor's address, 23.01.2017) reports services started on the remaining elevated stretches but underground stretches not yet operating. C2 expects underground completion by mid 2018. The exact start date of the elevated services is not given; the date is when C3 reports them running.

No extract mentions a Dr. B.R. Ambedkar Foundation or a Rs.5 crore allocation for it. C1, C2, C3 and C5 concern the Tamil Nadu Dr. Ambedkar Law University grants and law colleges; C4 concerns Adi Dravidar welfare schemes. These are different subjects.

No extract shows new awards named after Tamil scholars for service to the Tamil language. C2 mentions a student award named after Kamarajar and teacher awards; C3 mentions existing arts awards (Kalaimamani, Bharathi); C1, C4 and C5 are unrelated awards or indexes.

cited.quote: the Supreme Court on 20.9.2016 ordered that the Union of India shall constitute the CMB within four weeks
Supreme Court on 4.10.2016 directed that the constitution of CMB may be deferred
directed Government of India to frame a Scheme to implement its Judgement within six weeks

rationale: The state pressed the issue in the Supreme Court and obtained an order (C1, 20.9.2016), but the Court deferred the constitution of the Board on 4.10.2016 (C1). C5 shows the 16.02.2018 judgement directed the Union to frame a scheme. Constitution of the Board and Committee rests with the Union, and the extracts do not show it.
